proposal: Stop re-writing the same six components: most of these 4,312 lines are the same rail, link, chip, tile, hero and seam written again under a different prefix. First, replace the lines that only re-spell an existing word (.card, .btn, .h4, .muted, .darken-1, .flow, .measure, .wall, .grid.three, ext/tabs .tab) with that word in the markup. Second, build five small shared components once (app-shell, nav-link, chip, tile, count-wall) and let practice, shell, blogx, shells and sections wear them. Third, labs/decks, mag, screens, sections, shells and blogx are near copies of public/imagine/* (decks is byte-identical), so keep one copy of each and delete the other. Only the wireframe drawing in layouts.css, the trees connectors and the lab-specific scroll and sticky behaviours are genuinely this module's own.

generalize.name: app-shell (rail | main | aside grid with head/foot, collapses by container width)
nav-link (a row link with a hover tint and an accent edge when active; wraps ui-tree-row / ext/tabs .tab)
chip (pill link with an on state, built on ui-pill / ui-badge.outline)
tile (a link card: fill, hover ring, radius, optional picture; extends .card)
display-block (a container-scaled block: eyebrow, huge title, rule, note; sizes in cqw)
count-wall (1/2/3/4/6/8 columns stepped by container width)
hero-band (fold-height hero band with a row layout when wide)

risk: medium: most swaps change looks slightly (a card or button reads a little different), and app-shell/nav-link touch five reference demo pages, but no runtime logic changes.
